# Node reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.js from app/src/engine.js. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs`. -->

Every node, grouped by the category you see in the add-node search. The code under each name is how to write it in the [Script language](script-language.md).
Any number input also accepts a **list**; lists are matched up item by item (a single number is repeated to fit).

## Values

### Number

```
number(value = 1)
```

A single number you can tweak.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number or list | 1 |  |

Gives: numbers.

### Time

```
time(speed = 1)
```

Seconds since the sketch started. Connect it to animate things.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `speed` | number or list | 1 |  |

Gives: numbers.

### Series

```
series(count = 10, start = 0, step = 1)
```

A list of numbers counting up: 0, 1, 2, 3…

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number or list | 10 |  |
| `start` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `step` | number or list | 1 |  |

Gives: numbers.

### Random

```
random(count = 10, min = 0, max = 1, seed = 1)
```

A list of random numbers between min and max.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number or list | 10 |  |
| `min` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `max` | number or list | 1 |  |
| `seed` | number or list | 1 |  |

Gives: numbers.

### Math

```
math(a = 0, b = 1, op = add)
```

Add, multiply and more. Works on whole lists at once.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `a` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `b` | number or list | 1 |  |
| `op` | choice | `add` | `add`, `sub`, `mul`, `div`, `mod`, `pow`, `min`, `max`, `sin`, `cos`, `abs` |

Gives: numbers.

### Remap

```
remap(value = 0, inMin = 0, inMax = 1, outMin = 0, outMax = 100)
```

Convert numbers from one range to another.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `inMin` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `inMax` | number or list | 1 |  |
| `outMin` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `outMax` | number or list | 100 |  |

Gives: numbers.

### Wave

```
wave(value = 0, type = sine, period = 100, amplitude = 1, offset = 0)
```

Turn numbers into a smooth wave (sine, square, triangle…).

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `type` | choice | `sine` | `sine`, `square`, `triangle`, `sawtooth` |
| `period` | number or list | 100 |  |
| `amplitude` | number or list | 1 |  |
| `offset` | number or list | 0 |  |

Gives: numbers.

### Snap

```
snap(value = 0, grid = 10)
```

Round numbers to the nearest grid step.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `grid` | number or list | 10 |  |

Gives: numbers.

## Points

### Grid

```

```

| `cols` | number or list | 10 |  |
| `rows` | number or list | 10 |  |

| `height` | number or list | 400 |  |


| `count` | number or list | 12 |  |

| `start` | number or list | 0 |  |

```

```

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number or list | 100 |  |
| `width` | number or list | 400 |  |

### Attribute


Read a number from every point: x, y, index, angle…

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pts` | points |  |  |
| `attr` | choice | `x` | `x`, `y`, `index`, `u`, `v`, `angle`, `degrees`, `distance` |

Gives: numbers.

### Noise Field

```

```

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |

| `pts` | points |  |  |
| `scale` | number or list | 0.005 |  |
| `time` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `amount` | number or list | 1 |  |

Gives: numbers.

### Move Points


| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pts` | points |  |  |
| `dx` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `dy` | number or list | 0 |  |

Gives: points.

## Modify

### Transform

```
transform(geo, x = 0, y = 0, rotate = 0, sx = 1, sy = 1)
```

Move, rotate and scale shapes.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geo` | shapes |  |  |
| `x` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `y` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `rotate` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `sx` | number or list | 1 |  |
| `sy` | number or list | 1 |  |

Gives: shapes.

### Copy to Points

```
copy(geo, pts, scale = 1, rotate = 0)
```

Place a copy of a shape on every point.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geo` | shapes |  |  |
| `pts` | points |  |  |
| `scale` | number or list | 1 |  |
| `rotate` | number or list | 0 |  |

Gives: shapes.

### Style

```
style(geo, hue = 200, sat = 0, bri = 100, alpha = 1, strokeW = 0, strokeBri = 100)
```

Set color, transparency and outline. Hue runs 0–360.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geo` | shapes |  |  |
| `hue` | number or list | 200 |  |
| `sat` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `bri` | number or list | 100 |  |
| `alpha` | number or list | 1 |  |
| `strokeW` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `strokeBri` | number or list | 100 |  |

Gives: shapes.

### Merge

```
merge(a, b, c)
```

Combine shapes into one group.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `a` | shapes |  |  |
| `b` | shapes |  |  |
| `c` | shapes |  |  |

Gives: shapes.

### Wiggle

```
wiggle(geo, x = 10, y = 10, seed = 1)
```

Nudge every shape by a random amount.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geo` | shapes |  |  |
| `x` | number or list | 10 |  |
| `y` | number or list | 10 |  |
| `seed` | number or list | 1 |  |

Gives: shapes.

### Reflect

```
reflect(geo, angle = 90, x = 0, y = 0, keep = 1)
```

Mirror shapes across a line.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geo` | shapes |  |  |
| `angle` | number or list | 90 |  |
| `x` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `y` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `keep` | number or list | 1 |  |

Gives: shapes.

### Align

```
align(geo, x = 0, y = 0, halign = center, valign = middle, mode = group)
```

Line shapes up to a point: left, center, right, top, middle, bottom. Treat the group as one, or each shape on its own.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geo` | shapes |  |  |
| `x` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `y` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `halign` | choice | `center` | `center`, `left`, `right`, `none` |
| `valign` | choice | `middle` | `middle`, `top`, `bottom`, `none` |
| `mode` | choice | `group` | `group`, `each` |

Gives: shapes.

### Distribute

```
distribute(geo, axis = horizontal, gap = 10, span = 0, center = 0)
```

Space shapes evenly along a row or a column, with a gap you choose or across a fixed length.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geo` | shapes |  |  |
| `axis` | choice | `horizontal` | `horizontal`, `vertical` |
| `gap` | number or list | 10 |  |
| `span` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `center` | number or list | 0 |  |

Gives: shapes.

## Paths

### Connect

```

```

Draw a line (or smooth curve) through a list of points.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pts` | points |  |  |
| `close` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `smooth` | number or list | 0 |  |

Gives: shapes.

### Curve

```

```

A bezier curve with two handles.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x1` | number or list | -200 |  |
| `y1` | number or list | 100 |  |
| `cx1` | number or list | -100 |  |
| `cy1` | number or list | -200 |  |
| `cx2` | number or list | 100 |  |
| `cy2` | number or list | 300 |  |
| `x2` | number or list | 200 |  |
| `y2` | number or list | -100 |  |

Gives: shapes.

```

```

### Wiggle Points

```

```

Nudge the points of a path so edges turn organic.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geo` | shapes |  |  |
| `amount` | number or list | 8 |  |
| `seed` | number or list | 1 |  |

### Compound

```
compound(geo, with, op = union)
```

Combine shapes into one: union (merge), subtract (cut out), intersect (keep the overlap) or xor.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geo` | shapes |  |  |
| `with` | shapes |  |  |
| `op` | choice | `union` | `union`, `subtract`, `intersect`, `xor` |

Gives: shapes.

## Output

### Output

```
output(geo, hue = 0, sat = 0, bri = 6)
```

What appears on the canvas. Set the background color here.

| Input | Kind | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geo` | shapes |  |  |
| `hue` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `sat` | number or list | 0 |  |
| `bri` | number or list | 6 |  |

Gives: nothing (this node is the end of the graph).
